title: sketch-orca engine manifest (sketch-orca-engine/1)
description: manifest.json at the top of a staged engine folder: what the engine is, what it was built from, and every other file of the folder with its size and SHA-256. A client finds the executable, the resources folder and the library folder through it. engine.exe must be one of the files; protocol/README.md has the other rules a schema cannot state.

stageVersion.description: The layout of the staged folder; a stage of an older version is made again.

exe.description: The executable, relative to the folder.

resources.description: The folder a job's resources names, relative to the folder.

libraryPath.description: The folder of the engine's libraries, relative to the folder (Linux and macOS: put it on LD_LIBRARY_PATH or DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH).

orca.description: The OrcaSlicer release the engine is built from (orca.lock.json).

cli.description: A hash of the front end's sources (cli/) the engine was built from.

runtime.description: The libraries shipped next to the engine.

inputs.description: A hash of what staging read.

files.description: Every file of the folder but manifest.json, sorted by path.

relativePath.description: A path relative to the engine folder, with forward slashes, that stays inside it: no leading slash, drive or backslash, and no empty, . or .. part.
